answer: Each identity must hold one state-licensed midwife certificate, registry-checked: holder, licence and clinic must match, and one pearl-white certificate backs exactly one identity; a second claim is refused. Earning it takes an accredited programme, 400 supervised births at the wharf-side clinic, and a state exam: 2,200 units and 730 days of training, so 100 fakes cost 220,000 units and 73,000 days. Cheapest cheat: hiring a licensed midwife to lend her certificate — she surrenders her own licence, faces deregistration, and a forged jade-green serial fails the registry check.
